text.2:50: And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.
text.7:64: But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and We drowned those who denied Our tokens. Lo! they were blind folk.
text.7:136: Therefore We took retribution from them; therefore We drowned them in the sea: because they denied Our revelations and were heedless of them.
text.8:54: (Their way is) as the way of Pharaoh's folk and those before them; they denied the revelations of their Lord, so We destroyed them in their sins. And We drowned the folk of Pharaoh. All were evil-doers.
text.10:73: But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and made them viceroys (in the earth), while We drowned those who denied Our revelations. See then the nature of the consequence for those who had been warned.
text.17:69: Or feel ye secure that He will not return you to that (plight) a second time, and send against you a hurricane of wind and drown you for your thanklessness, and then ye will not find therein that ye have any avenger against Us?
text.17:103: And he wished to scare them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him, all together.
text.18:71: So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship, he made a hole therein. (Moses) said: Hast thou made a hole therein to drown the folk thereof? Thou verily hast done a dreadful thing.
text.21:77: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.
text.25:37: And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers.
text.26:120: Then afterward We drowned the others.
text.29:40: So We took each one in his sin; of them was he on whom We sent a hurricane, and of them was he who was overtaken by the (Awful) Cry, and of them was he whom We caused the earth to swallow, and of them was he whom We drowned. It was not for Allah to wrong them, but they wronged themselves.
text.36:43: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
text.37:82: Then We did drown the others.
text.43:55: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.
text.71:25: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
